name: EasyReZorder
description:
[Wiki Page](https://wiki.roll20.net/Script:EasyReZorder)

Simple z-order manipulation for Roll20 tokens, paths, and text objects. Move selected objects forward/backward by steps, to front/back, or ahead-of/behind a specific object.

**v1.1.0 - New features:**
- ScriptKit integration: help, man, whatsnew, motd, gen-help

Commands:
- `!easyrezorder forward [n]` -- Move forward n steps (default: 1)
- `!easyrezorder backward [n]` -- Move backward n steps (default: 1)
- `!easyrezorder front` -- Bring to front
- `!easyrezorder back` -- Send to back
- `!easyrezorder ahead-of <id>` -- Move ahead of a specific object
- `!easyrezorder behind <id>` -- Move behind a specific object
- `!easyrezorder check` -- Show z-order index of selected objects
